$comment: Every model HireZero uses, by purpose. Changing a route changes spend: review it like code. A data root can override routes with HIREZERO_MODEL_ROUTES (docs/adr/0008-model-routes.md).

prices.$comment: US dollars per million tokens, as {"input": n, "output": n}, for models served by an API provider. A route without a price cannot be used with one (docs/adr/0036-api-model-provider.md). Check each provider's price page; prices change.
